import json
from pathlib import Path

from makemarket.provenance import file_sha256, receipt

training_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo192.json')
guard_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo192_memory.json')
prior_path = Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo96.json')
training = json.loads(training_path.read_text())
guard = json.loads(guard_path.read_text())
prior = json.loads(prior_path.read_text())
root = Path('train/runs/qwen3.5-4b-rloo192')
adapter = root / 'adapters.safetensors'
checkpoints = list(root.glob('step_*'))
assert training['status'] == guard['status'] == 'completed'
assert len(training['history']) == 192 and training['initial_completed_groups'] == 96
assert training['history'][:96] == prior['history']
assert len(checkpoints) == 1 and checkpoints[0].name == 'step_0192'
assert file_sha256(adapter) == file_sha256(checkpoints[0] / 'adapters.safetensors')
record = {
    'provenance': receipt({'purpose': 'retain the fixed 192-group RLOO continuation before policy validation'}, training['model_revision']),
    'source': Path(__file__).read_text(), 'status': 'completed',
    'groups_completed_total': 192, 'groups_completed_before_segment': 96, 'new_groups': 96,
    'training_segment_wall_seconds': training['wall_seconds'],
    'prior_training_wall_seconds': json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo96_completion.json').read_text())['training_chain_wall_seconds'],
    'training_chain_wall_seconds': training['wall_seconds'] + json.loads(Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo96_completion.json').read_text())['training_chain_wall_seconds'],
    'mlx_allocated_peak_bytes': training['peak_memory_bytes'],
    'sampled_footprint_peak_bytes_approx': guard['sampled_footprint_peak_bytes_approx'],
    'initial_history_preserved': True, 'latest_resume_checkpoint': str(checkpoints[0]),
    'checkpoint_retention_verified': True,
    'retained_adapter_optimizer_bytes': sum(p.stat().st_size for p in root.rglob('*.safetensors')),
    'adapter_sha256': file_sha256(adapter),
    'input_sha256': {str(p): file_sha256(p) for p in (training_path, guard_path, prior_path, adapter)},
    'interpretation': '96 new groups resume the fixed RLOO96 adapter and Adam state; 192 cumulative groups is not 192 fresh groups. No validation improvement inferred from completion. All prior history is identical and frozen RLOO24 and RLOO96 files remain intact.'}
Path('results/training/qwen35_rloo192_completion.json').write_text(json.dumps(record, indent=2) + '\n')
print({k: record[k] for k in ('new_groups', 'training_segment_wall_seconds', 'retained_adapter_optimizer_bytes')})
